posts.title: Make git worktrees cheap for agents
posts.description: Agents work best in their own worktree. A worktree is only the tracked files, so everything else has to come from a shared cache, through one command.

posts.title: Give your agents a `check` command
posts.description: Speed up AI agents by giving them a single `check` command that runs all validation steps, eliminating wasted time on tool discovery and complex build processes.

posts.title: Optimize your developer environment
posts.description: Most AI tokens are wasted fighting dev environment friction, not doing meaningful work. Sharpen your axe.
